Glastonbury 2025: Wrapped

A reposted summary of my Glastonbury 2025 experience.

This is a repost of a post I originally made on 6th July 2025 on my old site. I had to adapt it from custom MDX to plain markdown in order to post here.

At the end of June 2025 I want to my first Glastonbury. To reflect on the weekend I wanted to pull together some stats and ratings from the acts I saw and the time spent there.

To put this together I used data from MusicBrainz, which is a community-maintained open music encyclopedia that collects music metadata and makes it available to the public. I wrote a program using their API to generate the MDX files used to display the artist information below.

Ratings are based on the atmosphere, performance, and of course the music. The other big factor was also my subjective experience of the set. Plus points for Sir Ian McKellen's appearance at Scissor Sisters. Minus points for sound issues at Inhaler.

Starting with the overall stats from the weekend:
